basicDetails.schemeName: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (General Stream)

children.text: The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
The student should be studying in Standard 11th & 12th General Stream.
The student should have 75% or more marks in Standard 10th.
The annual family income of the student should be up to ₹4.50 lakhs.
Assistance is given to the first 100 eligible students based on merit.

schemeContent.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (General Stream) and have obtained 75% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching fees, as per merit prepared at state level up to 100 students.
